title.en: Avatar reads collapse to one rule; drop the thumbnail column
title.zh: 头像读取收敛为一条规则并删除缩略图列

intent.en: Real-machine audit showed the avatar reads had drifted outside the friend contract: currentAvatarThumbnailImageUrl and profilePicOverrideThumbnail are documented only on CurrentUser/LimitedUserInstance and are no longer returned by either channel, currentAvatarImageUrl is an undocumented extra only REST returns, and iconUrl — the one field LimitedUserFriend declares — was never read. Collapse every avatar read into one rule (util.avatarFields, iconUrl first), drop the now-redundant avatar_thumb_url column so a single value backs the whole pipeline, and fix friend-add, which read location from a WS user object that no longer carries it.
intent.zh: 真机核查发现头像读取已经漂到好友契约之外：currentAvatarThumbnailImageUrl 与 profilePicOverrideThumbnail 只文档化在 CurrentUser/LimitedUserInstance 上且两个通道都已不返回；currentAvatarImageUrl 是只有 REST 才多返回的未声明字段；而契约内唯一声明头像的 iconUrl 从未被读取。把全部头像读取收敛为一条规则（util.avatarFields，iconUrl 优先），删掉已经冗余的 avatar_thumb_url 列让全链路只有一个头像值，并修掉 friend-add——它从已经不带 location 的 WS user 对象上读位置。

acceptance: 头像取值收敛为 util.avatarFields 一处规则：iconUrl 优先、currentAvatarImageUrl 兜底
已失效的 currentAvatarThumbnailImageUrl 与 profilePicOverrideThumbnail 不再被任何读取点引用
friends 与 users 表不再有 avatar_thumb_url 列，旧库启动时被迁移删除且 avatar_url 数据保留
读侧只按 avatar_url 推导 avatarKey（friendRow 与 selfUserForClient 同口径）
friend-add 从事件信封取 location，private 位置也判为在线，平台取 last_platform
新增叶子 vrcnotifier.infra.util.avatar-fields 记录该规则并激活
normify_validate 0 error，build 与 render 产物反映本次改动
note: TDD 全程留痕: 先写 15 个失败用例(6 个 avatarFields 单元 + WS 形状写入 + friend-add 信封 location/private + 删列迁移 + 自己 iconUrl), 逐一确认失败原因正确后实现; 实现中发现两处自埋问题并按纪律补 RED——①断言用 assert.equal(x, undefined) 在 x===null 时假通过, 收紧为 'in' 检查; ②friend-add 的 loc 换源后 u.location === 'private' 判断未同步, 补测后改为统一 rawLocation。最终 442/442 通过。真机复验: 迁移删列成功、51/51 avatarKey、抽样 6 张头像全部 HTTP 200 且 PNG 魔数正确、缓存从 52 个清空后按需重建。
